provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Clank! Legacy: Acquisitions Incorporated rulebook (Renegade / Dire Wolf)

steps.text: Find the current game on the Mission Reports and read its Prologue Passage in the Book of Secrets - it names the board side
Contract cards in a row above the board; Patron card (if given) in the Reserve
Franchise Board below the game board
Bank: Gold tokens and the shuffled facedown minor secrets
All black cubes in the Dragon Bag; Dragon Marker on the {s} space of the Rage Track
Reserve: Cultist, Mercenary, Explore and Mysterious Tome piles
Shuffle the Adventure Deck and deal 6 faceup; replace any Event or Dragon Attack cards, then shuffle those back in
A Mug token per player near HQ; a random major secret on each major secret space; mystic fruit whole side up; Artifacts on their value spaces; market items on the Franchise Board
Your deck box: 30 Clank! cubes, your disc on a figure placed on HQ, and a shuffled 10-card starting deck
Random first player, then clockwise; starting Clank! in the Clank! Area: {s}
Franchise Board stickers, Patrons and Contracts may change these setup steps
The starting player takes the first turn
